roles.name: canvas
roles.usage: The page. Everything sits on it.

roles.name: surface
roles.usage: Raised content: cards, panels, the sidebar.

roles.name: raised
roles.usage: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs.

roles.name: fill
roles.usage: Neutral control fill: secondary buttons, inputs at rest, chips.

roles.name: fill-hover
roles.usage: Neutral fill under the pointer.

roles.name: fill-active
roles.usage: Pressed or selected neutral fill.

roles.name: fg
roles.usage: Primary text and icons.

roles.name: fg-muted
roles.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, placeholders people must read.

roles.name: fg-subtle
roles.usage: Tertiary marks only: disabled text, large decorative numerals, separators' labels. Never body copy.

roles.name: ink
roles.usage: Primary action fill (the one most important button).

roles.name: ink-hover
roles.usage: Primary action under the pointer.

roles.name: on-ink
roles.usage: Text and icons on ink.

roles.name: line
roles.usage: Hairlines: borders, dividers.

roles.name: line-strong
roles.usage: Input borders and lines that must be seen.

roles.name: scrim
roles.usage: Behind modal dialogs.

roles.name: accent
roles.usage: The one color: selection, focus, live state, the brand mark.

roles.name: accent-hover
roles.usage: Accent fills under the pointer.

roles.name: on-accent
roles.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

roles.name: accent-soft
roles.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected rows, accent chips.

roles.name: accent-soft-hover
roles.usage: Tinted backgrounds under the pointer.

roles.name: accent-fg
roles.usage: Accent-colored text and icons on neutral or soft grounds.

roles.name: ring
roles.usage: Focus rings and the accent's visible edges.

roles.name: positive
roles.usage: Success: saved, running, verified.

roles.name: positive-soft
roles.usage: Background for positive messages and chips.

roles.name: positive-fg
roles.usage: Positive text and icons.

roles.name: warning
roles.usage: Needs attention, nothing lost yet.

roles.name: warning-soft
roles.usage: Background for warning messages and chips.

roles.name: warning-fg
roles.usage: Warning text and icons.

roles.name: critical
roles.usage: Errors and destructive actions.

roles.name: critical-soft
roles.usage: Background for critical messages and chips.

roles.name: critical-fg
roles.usage: Critical text and icons.

roles.name: light-core
roles.usage: Atmospheres: the core of the light (in light mode, the soft shade).

roles.name: light-edge
roles.usage: Atmospheres: the light's tinted edge (in light mode, the deeper shade).

roles.name: halation
roles.usage: The glow film gives bright things, in the accent's hue.
